protocol.name: solyra_glass_v1

description.summary: analytic glass shapes for shell surfaces

protocol.description:
Lets a shell client describe the exact shape of the glass on one of its surfaces as a small set of rounded rectangles, so the compositor can clip its background effect to them and bend (lens) the backdrop at their edges. It complements ext-background-effect-v1: the blur region still says where the compositor blurs; these shapes say what the glass is.
Surfaces without a solyra_glass_surface_v1, or with no shapes, keep the compositor's previous behaviour.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has a glass object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Existing glass objects are not affected.

request.name: get_glass_surface

description.summary: get the glass object for a surface

request.description: A surface may have at most one glass object at a time; asking again raises already_constructed.

interface.name: solyra_glass_surface_v1
interface.description:
Double-buffered: reset and add_shape change pending state, which is applied atomically with the next wl_surface.commit, so the glass shape and the surface contents always change in the same frame.
Overlapping shapes form one union body (clipping is their union); at a point near several edges, lensing follows the shape whose edge is nearest, ties going to the shape added first.

entry.name: invalid_shape
entry.summary: a size is not positive or a coordinate is out of range

enum.name: preset
enum.description: How the compositor treats the backdrop under a shape.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The surface's shapes are cleared on its next commit; it falls back to the default background effect.

request.name: add_shape

description.summary: add a rounded rectangle to the pending shapes

request.description: In surface-local logical coordinates. Width and height must be in 1..=16384 and x, y in -16384..=16384, or invalid_shape is raised. The radius is clamped to half the shorter side. At most 4 shapes may be pending.
